Subject: Disputed merchant charge + per-diem question for Chicago workshop

Team —

Quick heads up from the onsite planning queue: TravelRight flagged a merchant dispute that just hit our corporate card for the Feb 28 workshop dinner at The Gilded Spoon (charge appears on the card ending -7421). TravelRight attached a chargeback notice they received from the bank — I’ve attached that and the receipt bundle.

Two asks so we can close the card ticket and make sure customers are charged correctly:

- Connor: can you confirm whether TravelRight paid the restaurant directly or charged us and then billed NovaCorp? If TravelRight paid and the restaurant is now disputing, we need their copy of the signed receipt and any POS slip for the dispute file.
- Finance (Vivek): quick confirmation on policy — for enterprise workshops do we invoice external attendees/customers for their meals or absorb under card/expense? I remember a regional variance but need the authoritative line for this account.

Attachments: [chargeback_notice.pdf] — see TravelRight notes in the footer.

I’m looping Neha for sales perspective because NovaCorp’s procurement team is sensitive to being double-billed. Planning note: the Chicago workshop is next week (March 17–18), so we should lock this down fast.

Thanks,
Grace

Subject: Re: Disputed merchant charge + per-diem question for Chicago workshop

Thanks for the context — quick finance take:

1) Policy + immediate handling
- Per-diem: Redwood policy (internal doc) allows a modest per-diem for internal staff travel; we do not automatically extend per-diem to external customer attendees unless it's explicitly part of the SOW/invoice.
- Meals purchased on the corporate card for customer-facing events should either be invoiced to the customer (if agreed in advance) or expensed to the event budget. If TravelRight billed us and then invoiced NovaCorp, we need the invoice trail to avoid double billing.

2) Chargeback handling steps we need completed now
- Please send me TravelRight’s POS slip and the attendee sign-in sheet (Connor — you mentioned TravelRight can provide the POS slip).
- I’ve created a holding GL (6100-ONS) to park the charge until dispute resolution; if the bank rules in favor of the merchant, we’ll absorb to event budget. If the bank rules in our favor, we’ll clear the hold and post the invoice.

3) Reallocation / invoicing favor
- If NovaCorp can accept an invoice for the attendee portion, we should issue a one-off invoice referencing PO# 4498 and attach the itemized catering receipt. Neha — can sales confirm whether this is acceptable commercially?

Reference: per-diem and event billing guidance: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBWorkshopChicago

Vivek
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
